The move came as the city cracks down on overcrowding and the illegal subletting of multi-occupancy apartments. top.headline: Landlords given one year to meet shared housing rules
top.summary: Dubai authorities have designated over 40 areas for shared housing while cracking down on overcrowding. Property owners now have a twelve-month grace period to comply with the updated standards.
